h1: Bedfordshire Photo Booth Hire for Weddings, Parties and Corporate Events
intro: From riverside venues in Bedford to the banqueting suites of Luton, Boothdrop Entertainment supplies mobile photo booth hire throughout Bedfordshire. Packages start at £299 and always include a professional attendant, free delivery and setup, unlimited sessions, props and a personalised print design.

sections.heading: Serving Bedford, Luton, Dunstable and the whole county
paragraphs: Bedfordshire is compact and well connected, which keeps our travel simple. The M1 runs through the west of the county past Luton, Dunstable and Flitwick, the A1 serves Biggleswade and Sandy on the eastern side, and the A6 links Bedford with Luton through the middle. The A421 and the A5 cover Kempston, Leighton Buzzard and Houghton Regis. Wherever your venue is, free delivery and setup are part of the package.

Bookings come in from Bedford, Luton, Dunstable, Leighton Buzzard, Biggleswade, Flitwick, Ampthill, Sandy, Kempston and Houghton Regis, as well as the villages around Woburn and along the Great Ouse. Luton has its own dedicated page because of the volume of weddings and corporate events we attend there, and the advice on this page applies equally to the town.

sections.heading: Asian weddings, country weddings and corporate dinners in Bedfordshire
paragraphs: Luton and Dunstable host some of the busiest South Asian wedding calendars in the East of England. Banqueting suites there can seat several hundred guests, so planners usually want a booth with capacity: the Inflatable Booth takes up to ten people at once, and the Magic Mirror handles eight. For multi-day celebrations we can quote for the mehndi, the wedding and the reception separately, with a different print template for each occasion, and the attendant keeps the queue moving at the busiest moments.

Across the rest of the county, weddings tend to be held in country house hotels, converted barns and the larger village halls between Ampthill and Biggleswade. Our advice for those is to place the booth within sight of the bar or the dance floor rather than in a side room, because a visible booth gets used far more. Corporate clients around Bedford and Luton book us for Christmas parties, awards evenings and staff celebrations, and the branded overlay with a company logo is included at no extra cost.

Milestone birthdays, engagement parties and school proms fill the rest of the diary. For proms we bring a props selection suited to the age group and set up before the students arrive, so the booth is ready the moment the doors open.

sections.heading: Booth recommendations for Bedfordshire events
paragraphs: Big-capacity booths lead the way here. The Inflatable Booth is a glowing centrepiece whose LED colour can be matched to the wedding palette or a company brand, and it needs a 4m by 4m floor area with 3m of ceiling height and two sockets. The Magic Mirror remains the classic wedding choice, with on-screen animations and a print for every guest in the shot.

Where space is limited, the LCD SlimPod and the Selfie Mirror Pod both sit on a slim footprint and run from one standard socket. The SlimPod is our most affordable package, while the Selfie Mirror Pod adds a DSLR camera and instant prints for every guest, which makes it a good middle option for a wedding of 100 to 150 people.

sections.heading: Getting in, setting up and powering the booth
paragraphs: Banqueting suites usually have a dedicated loading entrance and a goods lift, and our attendant will liaise with the venue manager on arrival. Country barns and village halls are a different story: expect gravel drives, a couple of steps at the door and sometimes a single socket in the whole hall. We carry extension leads and a levelling base, so an uneven flagstone floor is manageable. Upstairs rooms are fine where there is a lift or a reasonable staircase.

Setup takes about 45 to 60 minutes before your hire window begins and is not counted as hire time. If your reception is in a marquee, we need a reliable 13A supply, ideally not shared with the caterers' equipment, plus a flat, dry spot under cover. Tell us the surface and power situation when you book and we will match the booth to it.

sections.heading: The kinds of venues we work in across the county
paragraphs: Bedfordshire's venue mix runs from country house hotels and estate barns through to riverside function rooms in Bedford, hotels near the airport, rugby and cricket clubs, school halls and community centres. Each has its quirks, but the booth requirements stay the same: a flat area of at least 1.5m by 2m, a socket within reach and a spot where guests will naturally gather. Share a floor plan or a quick phone photo and we will tell you exactly where the booth should go.

faqs.q: Is there anywhere for your attendant to park at a Luton banqueting suite?
faqs.a: Large banqueting venues normally have a service entrance and staff parking, and we will unload there before moving the vehicle. For smaller halls or hotels in Bedford and Dunstable, please let us know any parking restrictions when you book so the attendant can plan arrival and unloading time accordingly.

faqs.q: Can the booth be set up in a marquee at a Bedfordshire country venue?
faqs.a: Yes, as long as the marquee has a firm, level floor and a reliable 13A power supply within reach. We recommend a spot away from the entrance so wind and rain stay out, and we bring our own LED lighting, so the booth looks good even once the sun has gone down.

faqs.q: Do you charge extra travel for venues in Biggleswade or Leighton Buzzard?
faqs.a: Delivery and setup are included for every venue in Bedfordshire. If any travel contribution ever applies to a far-flung venue, it is shown on the quote up front before you pay a deposit, so the price you agree is the price you pay.

faqs.q: Can you provide a booth for a multi-day Asian wedding in Luton?
faqs.a: We can. Many Bedfordshire clients book us for the mehndi, the ceremony and the reception on different days, each with its own print template. Let us know the dates and venues together and we will put a combined quote together, with the £80 deposit securing the dates.

faqs.q: How much space does the Inflatable Booth need in a banqueting hall?
faqs.a: The Inflatable Booth needs a clear floor area of around 4m by 4m, ceiling height of at least 3m and two sockets. Most banqueting suites in Luton and Bedford have the room, but we always confirm with the venue before the day so there are no surprises.

faqs.q: Do you cover Bedfordshire Christmas parties and corporate awards?
faqs.a: Yes. December is one of our busiest months, with office parties and awards dinners in hotels around Bedford, Luton and Dunstable. The branded print overlay and digital copies are included, and we recommend booking early, because festive dates fill quickly.
